answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to stake a refundable deposit locked for weeks before it can earn, like a bridge toll paid before crossing an ocean: fake accounts must fund every copy, so creating ten thousand costs ten thousand deposits, while honest agents recover theirs. Add a slow saffron-coloured reputation ledger where peers vouch only after real work, so a fresh swarm has no history to spend and the attack capital and time cost dwarfs any reward.
